items.note: G.3.1/G.3.2 follow the paper's route (cancel-then-restore schedule, side wires cancelling unwanted coefficients, three stages giving (X,Y)->(-Y,X)), but omit the neighbour rules, the net change (JV+RG)x with central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2, and the stage-2 inverse schedule and composition (x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x).

G.3.3 states frames common to a gate's incidences, edge change D_vD_u^{-1}, commutation with pointwise gates and D_out S D_in^{-1}, matching lines 806-818; the per-route form epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} is not given, and there are no sub-steps.

G.3.4 mentions nested nondegenerate subspace labels and concludes s<Wm, but gives none of the defining content: no triple-indicator construction, no statement that the only decreasing edges are central wires losing h, no L=Ich, no sum Wm-2N+2L, and no L<N/2.

It states the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, the shear frames Phi_M giving H+D on every role, and the rank of P_V-P_U as in line 1159. It omits the source matrices -P_{U_a}, the extra rank one per X_a source edge, and the exact count s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, giving only s<Wm.

It states phase frames C_U, edge differences as products of kernels aI+bX_v, total s_c<W_c m and C^{tensor m} on every role. It does not say one kernel (or inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, omits s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and omits the diagonal (Z, i^{27k}) corrections and undoing of the signed exchange.
The strict inequality s<Wm and the use of tau with s/W<m^tau are stated. The deficits eta_b, eta_c, the fixed value tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, and the reason (L<N/2) never appear.

G.1 lists the elementary O(V) operations correctly. G.2 omits the hypotheses (prime q, denominators prime to q, offset preparable in b^{O(1)} time) and attributes the two-piece split/merge to unit multiplication too, which the paper does with c pieces (lines 591-603).

The shear derivation follows lines 1427-1446 faithfully: triangular changes by controlled shifts, then one interchange per one of Pi between two controlled updates. Lemma lem:lower-lower is only stated, not derived by the elimination of 1375-1392, and the fixed prime q avoiding the table's denominators is not mentioned.

The route (row split into W role streams, frame shears by recursive interchanges, H+D then the three-update interchange, recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), geometric sum) matches 1491-1557. It omits the fixed-tape depth-first schedule (1559-1615) that justifies O(V) overhead per node.

S1.2 states the address permutation and O(Vu^tau), with an accurate sketch: high digits as rows, padding, base-m pieces, radix-2 to radix-q padding. It is a single infer step without sub-steps, and unequal widths are not treated.

It gives s_c child calls on f=e/m axes plus a fixed number of row additions, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, as at 1903-1930. Missing are the conjugation by P_M that puts residual directions into coordinate slots (eq:phase-edge-coordinate) and the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z.

It states eight packed operations, restored third chunk, repair of a small exceptional set and O(V(L^tau+1)). It omits delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, the full bound with M A^3 and delta_bad terms, and the parameter-family conditions under which that bound reduces to O(V(L^tau+1)).

S2.2 gives the recurrence and S2.3 the geometric O(e^lambda) sum and the base-m partition. Missing are the leaf case F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta and its contribution e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}, which fixes lambda'>sigma+beta(1-sigma). Also missing: K<=e^{c/beta}, which makes the overhead O(e^lambda), and the q_0 row preprocessing.

It states the layer on D<=d chunks, exact Gaussian dyadic evaluation, one truncation with error below sqrt2 2^{-p} and O(Vd^{lambda'}), and the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) with p+Delta and Delta+3 bits as at 2565-2572. The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E that justifies Delta is not given, and the phase-frame step is thin (see phase-frame-recursion).

The sub-steps track the paper's proof: signed-shift roots and F^+F^-=I/t, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order B_t, grouped rounds H then y^E, prefix moves O(TpdK), at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), one layer call per remaining round, individual prefix rounds, error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, and final operators LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}.

It states evaluation at a power of two, multiplication with the established multiplier, centred residues and O(rp log(rp)). It omits B_0=2^{4p}, the four Gaussian-integer numerator products, the reduction mod y^r+1 and the returned Q_p(fg/r) with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}.

These steps follow the paper: retained LB order (and the commutation of pointwise product with LB in S4's motivation), the convolution-theorem normalization, the error 3delta+eta scaled by M to sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and M=T/r products at O(Tp log(rp)) (lines 3414-3495).

It states P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA and the tensor form with contractions and linewise error below dp^2. It omits the hypothesis theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4, the definitions of P_s, P_t, gamma=2d alpha^2 and the costs. The derivation at 3576-3792 is not reproduced.

Both identities are stated, and S5.4 gives the key reason RF^+R=F^+ and the commutation with pointwise products, as in 3951-3965. The chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) and the requirement that each t_i be even are not given. The unit-substitution and normalization steps are asserted rather than shown.

b, p=6b, d, the axis lengths r/2 or r, deterministic prime search and T/2<S<T are stated, kappa=2^{-182} appears in S0, and S6.2 gives no wraparound and c_j<2^{3b}. Missing are the fixed exponents (tau, lambda, c, lambda', epsilon, delta), K=floor(d^c), alpha, gamma, eta=1/(4d) and the prime window (1-2eta)t_i<s_i<=(1-eta)t_i. T is loosely 'approx n/b' rather than in [4n/b,8n/b).

It states Phi: x -> prod x_i^{mu_i} as an isomorphism preserving cyclic convolution, implemented by triangular controlled shifts. It does not define mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i or give the triangular digit formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_jP_j, and it omits the cost.

The exact identity is derived as in 4303-4342: the twist by zeta^k, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=f*g/T. The computed version and its twist errors below 4 2^{-p}, which is the listed derivation range, are absent.

The source transform (A, chirp transform via complex convolution, B_0, 2^gamma, conjugation for the opposite sign) and the algorithm steps match 4456-4533, and S6.5 matches 4536-4541. The input digits' exact scaling by 2^{-b-2}, which the factor 2^{2b+4} undoes, is not stated.

The final bound 448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding to the unique coefficient in [0,2^{3b}) and carries are correct. The error chain (E_ring, chirp error, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, E_w<28 2^gamma T^2L), the disk margins and the use of gamma<=b/4 are not shown.

It states division by Tp, the seven dominant powers, min margin 2^{-181}=2kappa, the absorption of log factors by p^kappa and O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}), as in 4854 and 4983-4987. It does not list the normalized costs or their powers, does not identify g_2=epsilon c(1-tau) as the minimum, and omits setup, exceptional sorting and the small-n cutoff.
No step mentions the Schonhage-Strassen conjecture, the eventual lower bound or the liminf argument; S0 states only the upper bound.

errors.says: Multiplying a later field by a fixed rational unit costs O(V) 'by splitting each fibre in two pieces and merging them in swapped order'.
errors.paper: The two-piece split and swapped merge implements the cyclic offset only. Multiplication by c uses c increasing pieces merged by a residue counter, and negation reverses blocks through a stack.

errors.says: A power of two T approx n/b, with primes s_i 'just below' each t_i.
errors.paper: T is the power of two in [4n/b,8n/b), and the primes are chosen in (1-2eta)t_i<s_i<=(1-eta)t_i with eta=1/(4d), deliberately separated from t_i so that alpha^4 theta_i>p.

errors.says: Attaching nested nondegenerate subspaces to the gates makes the sum s of edge-difference ranks strictly smaller than Wm.
errors.paper: Nesting alone gives the budget Wm-2N+2L. The strict saving comes from the specific labels, whose only decreasing edges are the central wires (L=Ich), together with L/N=100/539 or 101/539<1/2. For the bit network the N extra source ranks must also be added.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the two finite networks through the power-width and arbitrary-width interchange, the phase-frame layer recursion, the synthetic transforms and ring convolution, resampling with retained permutations, the CRT and twist reductions, exact recovery and the cost table to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out at the root of the saving. The label dimension budget (L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L, L<N/2) and the explicit deficits giving tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} are never stated, so s<Wm is asserted rather than supported. Lower down, the guard-width depth recurrence, the leaf term fixing lambda', the error chain E_s to E_w and the list of normalized cost powers are only summarized.
